extensions.description: This agent's interface is MCP over stdio, not A2A. The card is a capability manifest and discovery record, not an A2A endpoint declaration; no A2A endpoint exists for this agent. The params carry the invocation facts a client config generator needs to wire this server from the card alone.

description: Fleet memory MCP: cross-repo memory, trackers, idea register, lessons and roadmaps under lane law. Records are born classified — origin lane, content label, and evidence from birth — and NSFW-pure lessons never reach Qompass callers. This card is a discovery record and capability manifest for catalogues, registries, and client-config generators; Bloch does not expose an A2A endpoint.
name: Bloch

skills.description: Search, read, propose, and promote memory records across the estate's repos (memory_search, memory_get, memory_propose, memory_promote).
skills.name: Memory store

skills.description: Search the lessons corpus and look up or register ideas in the estate's idea register (lessons_search, idea_lookup, idea_register).
skills.name: Lessons and ideas

skills.description: Tracker and roadmap state with rollups — the estate's progress records in queryable form (tracker_state, tracker_rollup, roadmap_state, roadmap_rollup).
skills.name: Trackers and roadmaps

skills.description: Record and list skill-outcome records; an outcome record requires a result, and unclassified records are refused at intake (outcome_record, outcome_list).
skills.name: Outcome ledger
